title: Формат, сетка и инструменты тайла (крейт osmtiles)
goal: Общий фундамент упаковщика и клиента: схема protobuf, сетка O1, контейнер и кодек O3, команды dump/stats/cover/manifest, золотые образцы для контрактных тестов Rust/Python/GDScript.
plan_ref: OT-1. Формат, сетка и инструменты тайла

accept.name: cargo_ok
accept.cmd: cd tools/osm_tiles/packer && cargo test --release 2>&1 | grep -c 'test result: ok'

accept.name: cover_inside
accept.cmd: tools/osm_tiles/packer/target/release/osmtiles cover --poly /home/greg/deltaplan_data/osm_pack/slovenia.poly > /tmp/ot1_cover_$DP_TASK.txt && python3 -c "import json;r=json.load(open('tools/research/osm_pack/results/tiles20_slovenia.json'));ins={k.replace(',',' ') for k,v in r['tiles'].items() if v.get('inside')};c={l.strip() for l in open('/tmp/ot1_cover_$DP_TASK.txt')};print('missing',len(ins-c),'of',len(ins))"

accept.name: sample_dump
accept.cmd: tools/osm_tiles/packer/target/release/osmtiles dump tests/contracts/osm_tiles/sample_v1.dpt | python3 -c "import json,sys;a=json.load(sys.stdin);b=json.load(open('tests/contracts/osm_tiles/sample_v1.json'));print('equal' if a==b else 'DIFF')"
